name: Reviewed hab talo marker and verb pairing
scope: Exact reviewed Somali hab talo marker+verb pairs from the CUN paradigm
description: Treat hab talo markers and their following verb forms as contextual agreement pairs. Ambiguous markers such as ha, an, and ad are resolved only by exact reviewed pairings. Negative markers such as yaanu/yuusan and yaanay/yaysan pair with the person-neutralized cunin surface in the cited paradigm.
source: Qaamuuska Af-Soomaaliga (Puglielli & Mansuur, 2012), Shaxannada CUN, p. 922: hab talo
safety: Do not derive unseen jussive forms from suffixes or normalize reviewed alternative markers automatically.
